correctness.rationale: For every Dyck semilength n>=1, the first-return Catalan pair (B,C) with |B|=j is bijective both with ordinary path UBDC and with marked ground-level hill path BUDC. Thus the same uniform Catalan pair space gives uniform P and H-size-biased P* (since total marked hills=Cn), and A(P)-A(P*)=j>=0 under the stated sum-of-up-step starting heights convention. Pair counts give P(J=j)=Cj C_(n-1-j)/Cn, swapping pair pieces gives EJ=(n-1)/2. Therefore Cov(H,f(A))=E[f(A*)-f(A)]<=0 for every increasing f, strict for strictly increasing f when n>=2; covariance(H,A)=-(n-1)/2. Independently enumerated all Dyck paths n=1..8, validating area distributions, all threshold inequalities and exact rational covariance. This is a true all-n bijection; enumeration is supplementary. The n=1 zero difference boundary is covered.
